steps: Real field editor adds two overlapping-capable stable-UUID clip records to a schema2 sprite document, preserving every track and reviewing schema3. Schematic selection starts at global0.5/local0/frame1; local1 reaches global1.5/frame3. Chinese/English/Japanese at390px preserve focused authored name, cursor, selected UUID and full review. Cancel changes no author bytes or source draft.

Apply only updates the ordinary editor draft. Normal Save persists exactly the reviewed source with BOM/CRLF, while tracks, scene, assets, registrations, templates and all other author bytes remain unchanged.

Saved preview freezes the reviewed schema3 document and imported image. Actual Canvas pixels confirm Attack local0/global0.5 is green frame1 and local1/global1.5 is yellow frame3, Idle loops within its0.5s range, and whole selection restores frame0. The second instance retains its full sprite sheet. Switching a running preview pauses at the new clip start and no old clock advances it.
